title: Parenting With Impact | KinderCare Learning Companies
body_markdown:
Early Childhood & Beyond: Parents Are a Child's First (and Forever) Teacher


Hosts: Elaine Taylor-Klaus & Diane Dempster
Guest: Dr. Marquita Davis, KLC Chief Academic Officer


Chief Academic Officer, Marquita Davis discusses how KinderCare supports children by emphasizing parent-provider partnerships and community support to empower parents and enhance children’s early learning.


Listen to the full episode[here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XVf0nrWZuiI) .
